question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Ideal
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Excellent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is** "Ideal".**
 
• **"Ideal"** in English refers to a standard of perfection or excellence; something that is considered perfect and serves as a model for others.(आदर्श)
 
• Considering the given options, the most appropriate** synonym **for **"Ideal"** in this context would be: **'Excellent'.**
 
• **"Excellent"** in English refers to something that is extremely good or outstanding, very similar to an ideal standard.(उत्कृष्ट)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Excellent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's explain all the options:
 
 
• **Hefty:** In English, "hefty" refers to something large, heavy, or powerful. It's used to describe physical weight or size, and sometimes to describe large amounts of something (like a hefty sum of money). (भारी)
 
• **Bad:** In English, "bad" refers to something that is not good in quality(बुरा)
 
• **Intact: **In English, "intact" refers to something that remains untouched or uninjured; kept or left whole(अक्षुण्ण)
